question: What is the aim of the Annapurna Yojana of the Government of India?

options.text: To provide food grains to children
To provide food grains to women
To provide food grains to senior citizens

solution:
The Correct Answer is __**To provide food grains to senior citizens.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Annapurna Yojana**

 
 
• **​**Annapurna Scheme was launched in the year 2000 with effect from 1st April by the Ministry of Rural Development.
 
• It is a Central Sector Scheme. It is one of the sub-schemes of the National Assistance Program.
